frontmatter.title: Bash Folder Size Checker: From One-Liner to Production-Ready Monitor
frontmatter.subheading: A quick tutorial to measure directory disk usage with du, sort, and smart Bash patterns that scale from laptops to servers
frontmatter.excerpt: Learn how to measure and monitor disk usage in Linux directories using Bash, from a simple du one-liner to a robust folder size checker script with sorting, excludes, thresholds, and cron automation. Perfect for developers and sysadmins aiming to keep servers healthy and storage under control.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
